name: Constrained Smoothing for Level-Set Extraction
definition: A method to smooth the 0.5 level-set of binary volumes to improve mesh quality while preserving fine details, implemented via constrained optimization of a discrete Laplacian energy.
summary: Constrained smoothing smooths binary volume level-sets via discrete Laplacian optimization, preserving fine details by enforcing hard constraints that prevent the level-set from crossing its original position.
